title: I hate the ender dragon and the ghast
description: Craftable Ghast tear and Dragon's breath
body:
makes you have some ways of crafting the ghast tear and the dragon's breath

![ghast tear recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ab9e2496a102c4fa95707e969d1633072d58ed3.png)
![ghast tear recipe incase you made your quartz into blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60672334c310296799ff1a77935c5ef494d3fd61.png)

to get dragon's breath you have to smelt obsidian/crying obsidian/eye of ender and wait 3 minutes, after that it rewards you with 300xp(0-14 levels)
